Channel.title: Channel
Channel.description: Represents a television broadcast channel with stream URL, current show info, and guide events.

id.description: V4 UUID or custom handle unique ID.

name.description: Display name of the TV channel.

logo.description: Display icon representation typically an emoji.

streamUrl.description: Relative or fully-qualified HLS stream pathway ending in m3u8.

category.description: Filtering category group (e.g. Sports, News, Cartoons, Others).

currentShow.description: Title of the active on-air show.

currentShowTime.description: Time indicator of the broadcast show status.

nextShow.description: Title of the preceding upcoming schedule event.

guide.description: Array of GuideEvent schedules of upcoming TV shows.

channels/{channelId}.description: Collection of global TV channels accessible and editable by admin-level screens.
